messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH latency on inference-api (p95 > 1.2s) in us-west-2. Triggered by 3/5 route controllers. Incident ID INC-2024-42
oncall-bot: bridge created -> https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2024-42
laura: seeing it, investigating.
mike: ack. joining bridge.
jeff: looking at metrics — KV-cache evictions spiked, batching depth increased.
nidhi: starting fallback to smaller model variants on the dedicated pool (gradual ramp).
mike: rolling 30% traffic -> small-quant-model now.
laura: any customer-facing 5xxs? product-support?
product-support: no 5xxs reported, but one enterprise customer messaged about chat slowdown.
jeff: no deploys in last hour. suspect batching heuristic + intermittent long-context requests.
emma: adding more tracing to a few sample requests to check sequence length distribution.
oncall-bot: Reminder: follow the incident runbook. If customer impact >10m, notify account teams.
mike: latency improving after fallback; p95 down to ~420ms.
nidhi: continuing to monitor, will keep fallback until we patch heuristics.
laura: note: KV-cache thrash correlates with eviction spikes and long prefix reuse.
product-support: capturing the customer's logs; will prepare a summary for account managers.
mike: closing bridge in 10m if stable.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-42 marked resolved (root cause suspected: batching heuristic regression).
laura: scheduling postmortem — propose Mon 10:00 PT (2024-03-04 17:00 UTC) or Tue 15:00 PT. prefer Mon.
jeff: Monday works for me. will draft agenda.
emma: initial action items from bridge notes:
- Add leaky-bucket cap to batching heuristic (owner: jeff, due: 2024-03-08)
- Add KV-cache eviction alert with lower threshold + dedicated metric (owner: laura, due: 2024-03-04)
- Create synthetic test to reproduce long-context batching pattern (owner: emma, due: 2024-03-11)
- Draft customer comms for affected accounts (owner: product-support, due: 2024-03-03)
mike: ops followups: propose a suppression window for transient p95 spikes < 3m to reduce pages (owner: sre-rotation / nidhi, due: 2024-03-05).
nidhi: will take suppression work; also propose grouping alerts by pool id instead of host to reduce cardinality (owner: nicholas, due: 2024-03-07).
laura: SLO follow-up: keep availability SLO but adjust p95 alert thresholds and create a p99 runbook. owner: laura, due: 2024-03-10.
jeff: opened runbook PR for batching fallback -> https://git.redwood/r/runbooks/merge/234 (needs review).
emma: added dashboard snapshot for the incident board -> https://dash.redwood/boards/latency/INC-2024-42
product-support: will not send external customer comms until postmortem signoff; drafting internal note now.
mike: quick ops checklist from retro:
- post-deploy smoke check on dedicated pools to catch batching regressions
- dedupe alerts by incident id metadata
- add 3m suppression for ephemeral p95 spikes
jeff: +1 for dedupe by incident id — we can add metadata in alert payload to support correlation.
nidhi: assigning suppression and dedupe tickets to myself.
laura: recap of owners: jeff (batching PR), laura (KV alert), emma (synthetic test + dashboard), product-support (comms), nidhi (suppression/dedupe), nicholas (alert grouping).
oncall-bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled: 2024-03-04 17:00 UTC (Mon 10:00 PT). Calendar invite sent.
mike: thanks everyone. please add timeline snippets and logs to the postmortem doc before the meeting.
product-support: recorded customer impact: ~0.8% sessions with latency >1s over a 12m window; one customer reported degraded UX.
jeff: will update model routing policy to prefer smaller model variants when eviction rate > threshold.
laura: filed action tracker tickets -> https://phab.redwood/T3421. I'll populate timeline + attach heatmaps.
emma: pinging owners for due-date confirmations.
laura: final note: aim for SLO alert tuning in the next sprint and reduce noisy pages by 40% via suppression/dedupe work.
mike: closing thread — followups tracked in action tracker and postmortem doc.
